stops.note: literally "body"; also used for a whole composed of united parts, a guild, or a political body
originally used for the incarnation of Christ taking on a body
first meant persons united in a body for a shared purpose; by the 1610s narrowed to the legal sense of an artificial person created by law
stops.meaning: a legally authorized entity, an artificial person created by law

current_meaning: a legal entity, such as a business or organization, authorized to act as a single person under the law
